reviews.text: Affordable Prices! They took me as a walk in and I was there for only about an hour total. They offered extensions knowledge and general education and explained the issue my pet was experiencing. They discussed preventative measures and a care plan moving forward. My cat was seen, treated on the spot and I was sent home with meds for less than $170. They also offer affordable grooming options!
Fabulous service, good prices

Dr. Jose was absolutely the best! He was incredibly helpful, kind, and efficient when he took care of my doggy Suzy today. He made sure she was well taken care of and took the time to explain everything to me, which really helped ease my worries. I’m so grateful for the care and attention he gave Suzy. You can truly tell that he cares about his patients and their owners. Thank you so much, Dr. Jose for taking such great care of my baby 🐶❤️

I cannot rave enough about this place! From the staff to the Dr's they are friendly and have all the information. They try their best to accommodate you as busy as they get and the lobby and rooms are super clean
This is the best place for my baby. I would recommend this place to anybody ❤️ employees are professional.

Great compassionate care. Dr. Taylor is amazing and takes time to talk you through what is going on with your pet. Pricing is very. reasonable. Have been coming here for a while and it is always kind and compassionate care! Would recommend!
Excellent attention att: anubis❤️🐱 …

This place is HORRIBLE! The girl in the front with the thick lashes and overgrown nails is so rude, they pick and choose who they want to be seen first they don’t even go in order! The waiting time is the worst and mainly because they sit around talking. The vet came in for 60 seconds and when my spouse asked a question he said “What!” as if the question irritated him and walked out. Please spend your money on somewhere better than this place. You can hear people complaining in the lobby of the long waiting times.

I am disappointed with Alief Animal Hospital’s pricing practices. I brought my healthy dog in only for a rabies vaccination and nail trim, but I was told I also had to pay a consultation fee even though there was no illness or medical concern to evaluate.

When I questioned the additional charge, I was told that the consultation was required by law. However, I later learned that Texas law requires dogs to have a current rabies vaccination, but it does not specifically require owners to pay a full consultation fee just to receive a rabies vaccine or nail trim.

This has happened to me before at the same hospital. I understand that the hospital may have its own policies, but customers should be told honestly when something is a clinic policy rather than being told it is required by law. All charges should also be clearly explained before services are provided.
Excellent service, I like it, it's very clean, they only accept dogs and cats.
They serve you well and quickly
First time visit to Alief Animal Hospital.   It is very clean inside and the staff was very nice.  I just stopped in to pick up paperwork for my dogs dental cleaning tomorrow. Will follow-up later.

Jose, our dog technician, was absolutely wonderful! He was very helpful, knowledgeable, and took the time to answer all of our questions. He was patient and great with our dogs, which made us feel very comfortable. We truly appreciate the excellent service and care he provided. Thank you, Jose, for doing such a great job! We highly recommend him! 🐾❤️ Rojo, Sancho, and Oreo say THANK YOU, Jose! 🐾❤️ They appreciate you too! 😊
I like the friendly groomer. I will come back.
Horrible job! Asked them to bath my dog and they never did ! The same stain that was on my baby was on her when I picked her up !!!! Horrible horrible horrible
You can’t beat the price at all….. it’s a lil chaotic with the first come first serve system but they are vey nice ppl , I felt a lil bad they looked overwhelmed for a Saturday
Great vets here,  reasonable prices we like this hospital for our pets
Many thanks to Dr. José for his attention; he was very attentive and professional.
Excellent. Incredible prices.
Very good service

I bring my dog ​​here to get her cleaned, have her nails trimmed, and her ears washed, and all they do is soak her, she smells like fabric softener, and they don't even brush her. I pay $65 for nothing?! And the receptionists are unprofessional and rude!! They're new; where are the others who were always here??? I hope they get a better dog groomer who does a good job and doesn't just charge $65 without doing their job!
We take our dogs there and they're great..
I really appreciate the staff there they are nice and respectful.i like that they are affordable because I really couldn't see myself not helping a stray cat when in need
There are many people waiting their turn, but you can go home and when it's almost your turn they'll call you back so they can take care of your pet.
First time taking my grandfur..what a pleasant and awesome experience..staff was professional and the affordability fit within my budget..if I could 100 stars would be given
I am comfortable leaving my cat's on their hands. I really like the person in charge of the grooming. He is very nice with them!🥰 …

I took my cat there because I saw their prices were affordable. I called first and was told I would be seen, but after driving for over 45 minutes, the woman at the front desk told me they couldn't see me—even though they should have, given that my kitten was in very bad shape. They shouldn't play with pets' health or waste people's time like that.

The receptionist had a truly appalling attitude; I brought in my dog, who was in critical condition, and although I was willing to wait over an hour, she spoke to my younger sibling in a very unpleasant tone.
Brought my cat to be checked and they sent me away to another recommended hospital to take my cat and told me they close at 4pm when online and on their store hours on the door saids til 5pm. 😒 …

Very caring staff, super affordable. They dont try to pressure you to get unnecessary treatments and spend extra money. We got called back quickly, the vet and techs were knowledgeable and gave our dog relief of her symptoms quickly. Very good visit.
Poor service. I went with my dog ​​in an emergency and they refused to help me.

The reception staff were very friendly and Dr. José gave us a level of care that no one has ever experienced; he left us all delighted. If you come, definitely ask for Dr. José, a very kind Venezuelan with years of experience.

I’m conflicted, I’ve been coming here for years. If you want routine, basic packages aka vaccines, shots etc this is the place to go. However, once you get into anything more than that they will try to swindle any money they can. This is known as a low budget clinic. I understand if they’re trying to make a profit, however it comes to a point.

Many of the people that come here are doing so ON A BUDGET. Yet, when they give you the final bill they will present you with a much higher cost because they include things that you did not ask for or were even explained about BEFOREHAND.

You have to go out of your way to ask them to take out the unnecessary items to lower the price THAT YOU WERE NOT TOLD ABOUT before they brought the invoice. If you were to blindly accept the first invoice they give you, YOU ARE BEING RIPPED OFF.

An item that cost 6$ dollars they are selling for 20$.

12$ would be a fair price, not 20$ I know businesses need to make money, however this is now beyond predatory due to the fact that many customers are low-income and ESL. They are not made aware of cheaper alternatives. Yes, customers should do their own research but this clinic will try to pull a fast one. I have been to different low income vets in the past which have offered cheaper alternatives to come to a resolution for the pets health. Aka, feeding sardines in water instead of buying omega 3 supplements ($$$), buying wound care from tractors supply etc

However the vets, technicians and receptionists are all lovely. I just shouldn’t have sticker shock every single time and then have to ask for x,y,z to be removed to a number I can actually afford.

I do not blame the technicians or the vet even, but this is disheartening.

Excellent clinic!!
José treated me; he was very professional, attentive, and helpful. I highly recommend him.
Great services and lower prices. Super knowledgeable team!
There is a long wait. But they will take care of all walk ins. That place is so clean. I was the last appointment and everyone treated me and my dog patiently and kindly.
It's my first time here, but it's not as expensive as some other places.
Never have I had a Bad experience in the past 25 years going there Dr. Thomas really cares thank you so much🙏 …
LOVE EVERYONE THERE!!! And there services are amazing you get what you need done and well. All my furry friends have been here and it was a wonderful experience all throughout

I felt compelled to finally write this review because the same situation has now occurred repeatedly, and it is inexcusable.

I recently brought my dog in for his yearly vaccines. I specified exactly why we were there, yet once we were in the exam room, he was given an allergy shot we had neither requested nor needed. We had also informed the staff member who treated him, likely a technician given that the veterinarian was present for barely two minutes, that our dog was scheduled to be neutered the following week. Despite this, he was injected with a steroid without anyone seeking our consent.

We only became aware of what had happened at the front desk, when we were presented with a bill higher than anticipated. It had not occurred to us that they would administer anything beyond the vaccines we had requested. As a direct result of that unnecessary steroid, we were forced to cancel his scheduled surgery.

For context, our dog does have a history of rashes, but our last request for an allergy injection was two years ago. Additionally, we had explicitly explained that the condition resolved after a dietary change and no longer posed any issue. We had experienced something similar with our cat, so we were already paying extra attention, but this is clearly becoming a pattern, as other reviews have mentioned similar experiences.

This is a huge issue, as medications and procedures are administered without any explanation of what they are or why they are warranted. More often than not, treatments proceed without clear approval, and you're simply handed a bill afterward. As a pet owner, I expect to be fully informed and to authorize any treatment before it is given, especially when they should have known a dog should not receive a steroid before being neutered. If you choose this practice, be vigilant about what they administer to your pet, and confirm every detail while in the exam room.

Well I was there for 3 hrs and they never seen my dog because it was 19 before my doggy so I left because they told me the wait can be all day long I got there at 10 a.m and left at 1 p.m they just take every single dog and some petrol me that the wait can be up to 8 or so hrs
Excellent service and good prices.

The staff is so unprofessional, My dog had ear surgery and we ask them if we could get a new cone for my dog because the old one was dirty from the infection residue and we asked the guy if he could change it and he was like “just change it like the other one”

DO NOT GO HERE IF YOUR PET IS SICK. Place is fine for grooming etc. If your pet is sick i highly don't recommend. Staff is rude, unprofessional, and undertrained. Went for a sick cat they x-rayed and said it may be cancer. So I paid 250 extra dollars to get a expert opinion just for them to say "not sure". Additionally, they sent the x-ray to the wrong email twice(they at least admitted to their mistake). Went to Memorial Cat Hospital they immediately identified the issue put my cat on life saving medication for around the same price.

Our cat had an accident and we were advised that she would need her leg amputated.  Alief Animal Hospital was able to complete the surgery the same day and took our her stitches 2 weeks later.
It is a first come, first serve format, but the ladies in the front will call you at home to come back if there are a lot of patients ahead of you.
My family will continue to use this hospital for all our pets' medical needs.

Dr. José is the best thing about that clinic… I feel very safe taking my kittens to him; I trust him completely. He's a top-notch doctor and professional! When you go there, ask to be seen by Dr. José!
I  have been taking my pets there for a couple of years. I moved clear across town but continue to make the 1.5 drive. They have great service from the front desk to the doctors to the tech staff.
It's very good, I always take my puppies there. I highly recommend it. The staff is very friendly, and the price is fair and very good since I have 3 puppies.

I love them, they're very kind.
They take good care of the dogs.
Excellent price. I had my dog ​​spayed two months ago and everything went well. They're very professional and I highly recommend them.
Dr. Jose, thank you for the help you gave us in caring for my pets and for the kindness you showed us upon arriving at the clinic.
Excellent place for pets, very friendly staff and affordable prices.
Honestly, I received the best service—highly recommended, and they were very friendly.

Today I was assisted by Ms. Araceli. Unfortunately, my experience wasn't the best. I felt she was annoyed during the interaction, and on several occasions, she spoke very quietly. When I mentioned that I couldn't hear her well, I sensed she became uncomfortable.

Furthermore, I tried to have a friendly conversation by asking about the new offices and how long they had been there, but her response was simply, "I don't know, I don't remember," without showing much interest in customer service.

I believe that in this type of establishment, customer service is fundamental. I have been a customer of Alief for many years and would like to continue doing so, but I think that friendlier, more cordial, and more professional service would make a significant difference to the customer experience.
Very pleased with the care my pet Osy received. Dr. José's treatment and suggestions were excellent. Thank you.
I’ve been calling and no one answers the phone. Why put your open until 8 when clearly front desk must be gone by 5pm.

I like this place because it’s affordable but they keep you on hold for several minutes to talk to someone over the phone. Long wait line as well up to 4 hours…. Customer service can improve as well. Overall 3 out 5 stars for this place.

Highly recommend it to everyone
They do great work  i took my luna there and she still alive thanks guys.

Prices were very reasonable. Building is new, clean, spacious so clients with their pets can have space from others. Lots of staff who know their business. Enjoyable experience. I took in a feral male cat for neuter surgery.

A beautiful spot... We were served by the owner himself. The food and service were 100% excellent—and it has a fantastic view of the ocean! I am absolutely in love with this place in Herceg Novi.🖐️💃❤️😘 …

I recently took my dog ​​to this clinic, and it's the best. It's very affordable and provides excellent service, which is why I give it five stars. It's so far away, but I prefer going to this clinic.

Excellent place! I always take my pets there for everything from checkups to baths and deworming. It's very affordable and the service is excellent.

An excellent place—I always take my pets there for everything from a checkup to bathing and deworming. It is very affordable and the service is excellent.
I think the staff are tired; they answer the phone very rudely, then they left me waiting for a long time and finally no one answered. Until I called again...
Thank you so much for the excellent care from Dr. José!
It's first come first served but you can leave and come back so it works out fine. Prices are very reasonable and everyone there is super friendly and I couldn't be happier with the service

I had the opportunity to bring my cat in for a medical check-up and they treated him incredibly well. Dr. Jose was extraordinary and provided fantastic service. Definitely one of the best veterinary clinics in the area.

*UPDATE* Place has gotten better. I added one star.

It's like the Little Caesars of animal hospitals. They'll get the job done, but it won't be a pleasant experience for anybody. Seriously, I've never been to an animal care place where everyone that works there blatantly seems to hate you, your pet, and their jobs. Very affordable boarding though, just don't expect anybody to tell you anything about how your pet is doing when they're there or how they did after. You just have to hope they were treated right 🤞.

Brought my cat in for a urinary blockage sometime last year. They took great care of him and even discharged him early when we learned he was too stressed out to stay hospitalized any longer.

A friend of mine is having similar issues with her cat, and the staff turned her away. Urinary issues are an emergency in cats, even if it's a UTI. Little disappointing to hear her experience was not as great as mine.
Walk in only so prepare to wait. Great prices. Helpful staff. They are very busy so don't be rude. Be patient. Would be 5 stars if the groomer was good.
I went with my sister for her sick blue pit bull. They showed care and concern. The tech and the vet were very gentle with everything and answered all questions.

Although at the time we had 2 Harlequin Great Danes, and only really had to take the male in for care, this place did an awesome fine job in serving all of our vet needs and went beyond their ordinary means to helping him; we highly recommended them to anyone!!!!!

The last vet I took my dog told me for two months my dog had bronchitis and kept repeating his medication without him getting any better, they even told me to put him down. I brought him to this vet, one look at his X-ray and they said he has fluid on his lungs, two injections and by that evening my dog was breathing better and since he has been on his medication he is doing so much better. I would whole heatedly recommend this place to everyone. Excellent and hard working staff and very professional. Also the price is as low as it gets,  they used my dogs x-ray from another vet instead of making me do another one like other vets were asking me to do. 100 starts for these wonderful people.

If you only care about low prices then this is the place to go. And that includes the DR requesting for unnecessary procedures that end up making your bill a high dollar amount anyways.
I’ve taken both my dogs here and both have had a horrible experience.
My most recent visit will also be my last. They recently renovated and moved their building just for looks. I waited 4 hours for a call to head back to the clinic because 20 people were in front of me, how convenient for a walk-in only clinic. I called beforehand asking if they can do anything about my dog with teeth problems, being told the doctor will see, just for them to say they will only clean his teeth and extract but not find out what the issue is.. Also the DR was in a rush and barely let me finish talking before leaving the room. All that time wasted to leave paying $35 office visit for nothing.
My other dog I took for an issue with yeast infection and DR sent her for a $400 lab (which came negative) and for her to get spayed. Only prescribed medication seems to work. But the DR doesn’t want to prescribe enough to not to come back every few weeks. She still has yeast infection. Waste of time and finding ways to keep paying for office visits. Never looking to fix the issue.
